$comment: Audio health watchdog values (D297 proposed). services/studio-ui/launch.mjs copies enabled..shutdownGuardMs into the host config key audioHealth (app/host/src/host_config.h). enabled false = report only (control page warning, no source restart).
source: docs/evidence/2026-11-08-game-audio-loss.md: win-wasapi retries a lost device every 3000 ms (RECONNECT_INTERVAL, obs-studio 32.1.2 plugins/win-wasapi/win-wasapi.cpp); noDataMs gives that one retry plus 2 s before the host steps in. shutdownGuardMs: a clean obs_shutdown took under 1 s in the 2026-11-08 host logs. maxParked (agent default 2026-11-08, D297 second opinion): replaced sources are parked, never destroyed while the host runs (a dead WASAPI source's destroy can hang), and they survive project reloads; 12 = 2 device sources x maxRecreates 3 x 2 loads. At the limit the watchdog stops restarting and says to restart Ujwalam after the stream.
